scope: All 55 main Sexual Ethics debate owners and all eight existing stage-reference mappings. Opponent source attribution classifications are editorial boundary judgments; they are not blanket original-text certifications.
method: Original primary passages of Curran (1986 speech; 1987 first-person article), Mill Chapter IV, Farley excerpts as quoted by CDF 2012, and mediated Fletcher book excerpts were compared with current opposition wording. Other source classes explicitly retain unresolved primary author/context checks. No implied authorization to treat non-magisterial positions as Church teaching.
